description: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability across six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The horizontal axis represents the “Per-specialty terms” categories, listed alphabetically from Cardio to Pediatrics, and is a categorical axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” represents a linear scale ranging from -22 to -27, with tick marks at integer values. Each specialty is represented by a set of bars colored in shades of orange, with a single bar for Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The bars vary in height, with the tallest bars for Cardio and Gastro reaching approximately -22.5, and the shortest bars for Neuro and Obstetrics reaching approximately -26.5. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
